payload.name: pc-check-retry-eligibility
payload.description: Deterministic pure-logic guard that decides whether a Tool invocation is eligible for a bounded retry, before any retry is considered. It performs evidence-conditioned logic only: it does not grant dispatch permission, does not reset attempt counts, and never replays completed effects. Returns retry: true only when outcome is exactly 'retryable', operation_state is not 'completed' (i.e. 'unknown' or 'not_started'), attempt < max_attempts with both exact positive integers (excluding bool), and read_only or dedup_verified is true. Any missing, null, or invalid input fails closed with retry: false and never raises. Completed effects never replay even when read_only or dedup_verified are true. This guard is a reusable building block for Recipe/usage failure contracts; it never bypasses current instance-wide Tool policy, cancellation, stale-attempt fencing, or resource limits, and it assumes the typed inputs mapping and Monty runner support are implemented on the selected path.
